title: festuca valesiaca subsp. parviflora
intro: Festuca valesiaca subsp. parviflora, commonly known as Alpine Fescue, is a type of grass species native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions attributed to Festuca valesiaca subsp. parviflora include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antifungal effects, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
